title: Per-language completion matrix — a tick only where every applicable dimension is green
method: joins M14.0.F5 (diff), M60.SHARP (sharp), M14.0.F3 (fixtures), M12 corpus-claims gate, M14.0.F1 (grammar audit), M60.P1 (line emission), reviews/* closure markers, and the dated tracker snapshot validation/m49/lang-open-issues.json; a missing dimension reports 'n/a' or is disclosed '~' and never counts as a pass, and a measured M60.SHARP row with hard>0 fails the lane

inputs.sharpness: validation/m60/results/oracle-sharpness.json @ absent — no lane has been measured under the written-target rule yet, so every diff cell above is the LEAF rule's

crossCuttingIssues.593: M37 dual-lens backfill: open for the languages still in its table, but java/kotlin/scala/ts/js rows are recorded ✅ done
crossCuttingIssues.864: M14 Matrix 4 grammar provenance/pinning: matrix-wide item that names fsharp+clean as examples, not their completion gap
crossCuttingIssues.930: m60 lines-cell wording: the gate asks `is line_number written anywhere` so ONE emit site satisfies it — the fix re-measures every lane's cell, so it is family work, not the named lane's completion gap
crossCuttingIssues.943: M60.R8/R10 adjudicate a COMMITTED artifact: the fix is a freshness pin every lane's census/register pair needs (family sweep), and both named instances — php's un-adjudicated surface, cpp's stale R10 row — are repaired at HEAD this round

columns.diff: M14.0.F5 MISSING/unexplained/fabrication all zero (leaf rule: the target's LAST SEGMENT)
columns.sharp: M60.SHARP: the target compared AS WRITTEN — hard=0 means the leaf rule hid nothing; hard>0 fails the lane; an absent row is disclosed (~), never a pass
columns.depth: every 200-file draw on the lane's pinned repo is MISSING=0 and unexplained=0 (60 is the canonical draw)
columns.fresh: M12 artifact pinned to input digests and confirmed to describe this tree (~ = unpinned, disclosed not passed)
columns.tracker: no OPEN issue names the language
